name: toolcrib
description: Per-category slice of component-manifest.json's "components" array (category: Overlays), for on-demand detail without loading the full manifest. See component-manifest.json for themeSystem/zIndexScale/eventBus and cross-category data.

components.name: AlertDialog

id.description: Unique identifier used for event bus targeting (e.g. `aiBus.openAlertDialog('confirm-delete')`). Auto-generated if omitted.

trigger.description: Element that opens the dialog on click. Rendered inline; the dialog manages open/close state automatically.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state. When provided, the component becomes fully controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Callback fired when the dialog opens or closes.

zIndex.description: Z-index layer. Uses the toolkit's Z_INDEX.MODAL tier by default.

ariaLabel.description:
Accessible name announced by screen readers when the dialog opens.
Always visually hidden, matching `Modal`'s `ariaLabel` — set this
explicitly (typically matching your `AlertDialog.Header` text) for a
meaningful announcement.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for backdrop blur and overlay darkness.

components.description: Blocking confirmation dialog that cannot be light-dismissed — for destructive/irreversible actions

components.name: CommandPalette

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

items.description: Array of items to render, fuzzy-filtered by `cmdk` as the user types.

emptyMessage.description: Content shown when no item matches the current search.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state. When provided, the component becomes fully controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Callback fired when the palette opens or closes.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for item density and max list height.

components.description: Fuzzy-searchable command launcher opened via Cmd/Ctrl+K, hosted inside the toolkit's own Modal

components.name: ContextMenu

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

items.description: Array of menu items to render.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for shadow depth and item density.

components.description: Right-click action menu, data-driven with separator support

components.name: Drawer

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

trigger.description: Element that toggles the drawer on click. Rendered inline.

position.description: Which viewport edge the drawer slides in from.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state. When provided, the component becomes fully controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Callback fired when the drawer opens or closes.

title.description: Title text rendered in the drawer header.

width.description: Width of the drawer panel (for left/right positions).

zIndex.description: Z-index layer. Uses the toolkit's Z_INDEX.DRAWER tier by default.

components.description: Edge drawer overlay with backdrop blur and slide animation

components.name: DropdownMenu

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

trigger.description: Trigger element that opens the menu on click.

items.description: Array of menu items to render.

side.description: Which side of the trigger the menu opens on.

align.description: Alignment along the menu's side axis.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for shadow depth and item density.

components.description: Data-driven action menu with separator support

components.name: HoverCard

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting.

content.description: Rich content shown inside the card.

side.description: Which side of the trigger the card appears on.

align.description: Alignment along the card's side axis.

openDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before the card opens on hover.

closeDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before the card closes after the pointer leaves.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for shadow depth and border.

components.description: Hover-triggered preview card for rich, interactive content

components.name: Modal

id.description: Unique identifier used for event bus targeting (e.g. `aiBus.openModal('my-modal')`). Auto-generated if omitted.

trigger.description: Element that opens the modal on click. Rendered inline; the modal manages open/close state automatically.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state. When provided, the component becomes fully controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Callback fired when the modal opens or closes.

width.description: Width of the modal dialog panel.

height.description:
Height of the modal dialog panel. Omit to size to content (the common
case) — set this for content that needs to fill a fixed amount of
space rather than shrink-to-fit, e.g. `<Viewer>`'s fullscreen-ish
lightbox.

zIndex.description: Z-index layer. Uses the toolkit's Z_INDEX.MODAL tier by default.

ariaLabel.description:
Accessible name announced by screen readers when the dialog opens.
Always visually hidden — unlike `<Drawer title>`, which is a visible
`ReactNode` header, this is a screen-reader-only string. `Modal.Header`'s
visible text is decorative only and is not otherwise wired to the
dialog's accessible name, so set this explicitly (typically matching
your `Modal.Header` text) for a meaningful announcement.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for backdrop blur and overlay darkness.

components.description: Dialog overlay with focus trap, backdrop, and slot composition

components.name: Popup

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

trigger.description: Required trigger element. The popup anchors to this element.

placement.description: Anchoring position relative to the trigger element.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state. When provided, the component becomes fully controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Callback fired when the popup opens or closes.

zIndex.description: Z-index layer. Uses the toolkit's Z_INDEX.DROPDOWN tier by default.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for shadow depth and border style.

components.description: Anchored popover with light dismiss and corner-squaring to trigger

components.name: Tooltip

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting.

content.description: Text or ReactNode rendered inside the tooltip bubble.

side.description: Which side of the trigger the tooltip appears on.

align.description: Alignment along the tooltip's side axis.

delayDuration.description: Delay in milliseconds before the tooltip appears on hover.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for theme (dark/light/accent) and size.

components.description: Hover/focus tooltip wrapping a child trigger element

components.name: Viewer

isOpen.description: Controlled open state. When provided, the component becomes fully controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Callback fired when the viewer opens or closes.

components.description: Fullscreen media lightbox — composes ViewerContent inside Modal

components.name: ViewerContent

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

items.description: Array of media items to display.

activeIndex.description: Controlled active item index. Omit to let `<ViewerContent>` manage its own state internally.

onIndexChange.description: Change callback fired whenever the active item changes, controlled or not.

onClose.description:
When provided, renders a close affordance (an in-content close button)
that calls this on click. Omit entirely for a standalone/inline embed
with nothing to close. `<Viewer>` wires this to `<Modal>`'s own
`onOpenChange`; `ViewerContent` itself never listens for Escape — that's
the host's job, not content's.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for nav button size and caption placement.

components.description: Media viewer content — zoom/pan and prev/next navigation, no overlay chrome of its own; host it inside a `<Modal>` (see `<Viewer>`), `<Drawer>`, `<Popup>`, or directly inline, of your choosing

value.description: Unique string value emitted in the `commandpalette:item_selected` event, and used by `cmdk` for filtering/selection identity.

label.description: Display label rendered in the item.

icon.description: Optional icon rendered before the label.

shortcut.description: Optional keyboard shortcut display, e.g. `'⌘S'`. Purely visual — does not register the shortcut itself.

group.description: Optional group heading this item is rendered under. Items sharing the same `group` are rendered together.

keywords.description: Additional terms `cmdk`'s fuzzy filter should match against, beyond `label`'s own text.

onSelect.description: Handler invoked when this item is selected via click or keyboard.

value.description: Unique string value emitted in the `menu:item_selected` event.

label.description: Display label rendered in the menu item.

icon.description: Optional icon rendered before the label.

disabled.description: If true, the item is visually dimmed and not clickable.

isSeparator.description: If true, renders a horizontal separator line instead of a clickable item.

onClick.description: Click handler for this individual item.

caption.description: Optional caption rendered below (or over, per `overrides.captionPosition`) the media.
